description: This Java class 'DeviceSpecificV15' implements device-specific behavior for an Android keyboard application, including input method subtype reporting, correction handling, gesture detection, and vibrator control.

classes.name: DeviceSpecificV15
classes.description: Implements device-specific features for Android API level 15, including input method subtype management, correction reporting, gesture detection, clipboard, and vibrator support.

methods.name: getApiLevel
methods.description: Returns the API level identifier for this device-specific implementation.

methods.name: createGestureDetector
methods.description: Creates a gesture detector with a custom listener.

methods.name: commitCorrectionToInputConnection
methods.description: Commits a correction to the input connection, updating the text and correction info.

methods.name: reportInputMethodSubtypes
methods.description: Reports available input method subtypes based on provided builders.

methods.name: reportCurrentInputMethodSubtypes
methods.description: Sets the current input method subtype based on locale and keyboard ID.

methods.name: createClipboard
methods.description: Creates a clipboard object for the application context.

methods.name: createSubtype
methods.description: Creates an InputMethodSubtype object with specified locale and keyboard ID.

methods.name: createPressVibrator
methods.description: Creates a vibrator wrapper for haptic feedback.
